products.title: ASUS ROG THOR 1600W Titanium III PCIe 5.1 ATX 3.1 Compatible Fully Modular Power Supply
products.body_html:
ROG THOR 1600W Titanium III

Featuring a GaN MOSFET, “GPU-First” patented intelligent voltage stabilizer and a magnetic OLED display, ROG Thor 1600W Titanium III delivers unmatched performance and rock-solid stability for your ultimate PC build

  • GaN MOSFET delivers up to 30% more power efficiency than standard MOSFETs and a more organized internal layout for cooler operation.    
  • "GPU-First" voltage sensing with patented intelligent voltage stabilizer enhances voltage delivery to your graphics card by up to 45% for smoother gaming and unwavering performance. 
  • Magnetic OLED display shows a real-time power draw and can be swapped to either side of the unit to accommodate fan-up or fan-down PSU installation. 
  • Turbo Mode: Premium components and a fine-tuned fan curve unlock support for extended power excursions. 
  • ROG heatsinks and a fully aluminum enclosure synergize for superior cooling, keeping your system thermals under control. 
  • Dual-ball-fan bearings can last up to twice as long as sleeve bearing designs. 
  • ATX 3.1 compatible: ROG Thor Titanium III is compliant with the ATX 3.1 standard, ensuring enhanced voltage and current regulation for the latest hardware. 
  • Etched modular cables with a pliable premium material ensure effortless cable management and exceptional safety. 
  • 80 PLUS Titanium certified: ROG Thor Titanium III utilizes low-ESR capacitors and premium components for industry-leading power efficiency. 
  • 10-year warranty included.
     

ENGINEERING

GaN MOSFET

The ROG Thor 1600W Titanium III PSU boasts an innovative GaN MOSFET that deliver up to 30% more power efficiency than standard MOSFETs. Plus, the smaller size of a GaN MOSFET allows for a more organized internal layout. This optimized design provides space for larger heatsinks and enhanced airflow, improving heat dissipation.

"GPU-FIRST" Voltage Sensing with patented intelligent voltage stabilizer (IVS)

Activate the "GPU-First" voltage sensing by connecting the IVS cable. This innovative feature enhances voltage stability by up to 45%, even during demanding gaming sessions and overclocking scenarios. If you prefer conventional CPU-focused voltage sensing, simply disconnect the IVS cable. With this advanced technology, you can experience smooth and consistent gaming.
*Disclaimer: The "GPU-First" intelligent voltage stabilizer is designed exclusively for 16-pin PCIe power cables. This feature is not available for 8-pin PCIe power cables.

High-performance Copper Pins

Upgraded PCIe® connectors feature superior thermal conductivity to help ensure cooler operation and improved power delivery efficiency. This translates to a significant 29% reduction in connector temperatures (up to 12.3°C), promoting optimal performance and stability for even the most demanding graphics cards.

ATX 3.1 Compatible

ATX 3.1 ushers in tighter voltage and current regulation standard for next-gen hardware - and the ROG Thor 1600W Titanium III arrives ahead of the curve with full compliance. A 16-pin PCIe cable capable of sending up to 600 watts of power to PCIe 5.1 graphics cards is bundled with this PSU, readying your build for the next gen.
*Please see the FAQ section for specific instructions on the proper usage of this advanced 16-pin cable.

80 PLUS & Cybenetics Titanium Certification

The ROG Thor 1600W Titanium III utilizes low-ESR Japanese capacitors to ensure efficient operation. These upgrades enable 80 PLUS Titanium certification, which guarantees 90% efficiency at 100% load and 94% efficiency at 50% load. It also earns the Cybenetics Titanium efficiency certification. The increased efficiency results in less heat, reduced fan noise, and increased reliability.

COOLING

ROG Heatsinks

Cool under pressure - ROG heatsinks facilitate lower temperatures, longer component lifespan, and extended 0dB operation.

Dual-Ball-Fan Bearings

2X longer lifespan - Dual-ball bearings boast a remarkable lifespan of up to 80,000 hours, twice as long as sleeve bearings and exceeding even fluid dynamic bearings. This helps to ensure long-lasting and reliable cooling with minimal noise for the ROG Thor 1600W Titanium III.

0dB Technology

Quiet intelligence - To reduce noise output, the PWM-controlled fan shuts off entirely when the PSU load is at 20% or below.
*In 0dB mode (button pressed), the fan continues to spin when transitioning from high to low loads, ensuring safe temperatures are reached before stopping.

EXPERIENCE

Magnetic OLED Display

This detachable magnetic OLED display showcases real-time power draw, providing insights to your system's performance and efficiency. The magnetic attachment can be swapped to either side of the unit for fan-up or fan-down PSU installation, depending on the design of your case, so you can maintain optimal airflow without compromising monitoring.

Turbo Mode

Turbo Mode unlocks support for extended power excursions, courtesy of a fine-tuned fan curve and premium components. Enjoy unwavering performance when you need it most, and switch between peak performance and ultimate silence with just a press of the Turbo Mode button on the rear of the PSU.

Etched Cables

Made from a pliable premium material, these etched cables are easily flexible during installation, and they operate at temperatures 50°C lower than the safety limit when routed for cable management. These cables also meet the rigorous standards of the UL1581 flame test and UL758 certification, helping to ensure a smooth PC DIY experience and exceptional safety.

DIY-friendly CPU Power Connector

Engineered with a distinct clip between the 4+4 pin connectors and a unique color scheme, this CPU power cable simplifies cable identification during installation. The integrated clip helps to ensure a secure and effortless connection to the motherboard's CPU power connector, streamlining the build process and instilling confidence in your PC setup.

10-year Warranty - A decade of power

We're so confident about the reliability of the ROG Thor 1600W Titanium III that we back it with a 10-year warranty.
*Core product operation is guaranteed for 10 years. The RGB LEDs are subject to a 3-year warranty.

products.title: Corsair AX1600i Titanium Modular Psu
products.body_html:
Corsair AX1600i Titanium Modular Psu

 

  • High efficiency: With its 80 Plus Titanium certification, the AX1600i operates with over 94% efficiency, which translates to less wasted energy and cooler operation.
  • World-class electrical performance: Reviews praise the 
    AX1600i
     for its incredibly stable voltages and ultra-low ripple noise, which provides a clean and reliable power delivery to your system's critical components.
  • Fully modular cabling: The unit comes with a full set of black, low-profile modular cables, allowing you to use only the ones you need for a cleaner, easier build.
  • Digital control: The digital design offers precise control over the PSU, including advanced performance monitoring and the ability to switch between single and multi-rail overcurrent protection via the Corsair iCUE software.
  • Silent operation: A 140mm fluid dynamic bearing (FDB) fan and a Zero RPM mode ensure that the PSU runs quietly under low and medium loads. The fan only spins up when necessary.
  • High-end internal components: It is built with 100% 105°C Japanese electrolytic capacitors and features GaN transistors for superior efficiency.

products.title: Corsair HX1000i / 1500i Platinum Modular ATX 3.0 PCIe 5.0
products.body_html:
Corsair HX1000i / 1500i Platinum Modular ATX 3.0 PCIe 5.0

 

ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 compliant Provides a native 12V-2x6 connector for compatibility with the latest graphics cards, such as NVIDIA's 40 and 50 series. The ATX 3.1 standard also handles transient power spikes, which is crucial for high-end GPUs.
80 PLUS Platinum efficiency Delivers up to 92% efficiency, which reduces heat and lowers electricity costs. The 
HX1500i
 has been tested to reach 94.5% efficiency in some loads.
Fully modular cabling Allows you to connect only the cables needed for your system, simplifying installation and improving airflow.
Digital control The power supplies are fully digital, offering precise power delivery and reducing coil whine and noise. You can connect the unit to a motherboard USB header to monitor performance through the CORSAIR iCUE software.
CORSAIR iCUE software integration Using iCUE, you can monitor power consumption and temperature, create custom fan curves, and switch between single-rail and multi-rail overcurrent protection (OCP). The 2025 HX1500i Shift model also includes an iCUE Link System Hub for simplified control of other iCUE devices.
Ultra-low noise operation A 140mm fluid dynamic bearing (FDB) fan combined with a Zero RPM mode ensures quiet operation at low to medium loads. For the 
HX1500i
, the fan stays off until the load exceeds 900W.
High-quality components Both units feature 100% industrial-grade, 105°C-rated Japanese electrolytic capacitors for reliability and durability.

products.title: Corsair HX750 Platinum Modular Psu
products.body_html:
Corsair HX750 Platinum Modular Psu

 

  • 80 PLUS Platinum certified: Ensures up to 92% efficiency, which leads to lower operating costs, less excess heat, and quieter performance.
  • Fully modular cabling: Allows you to connect only the cables your PC needs, which simplifies the build process, reduces clutter, and improves airflow inside your case.
  • Zero RPM Fan Mode: The PSU's 135mm fan remains off at low-to-medium loads, ensuring quiet operation.
  • 100% Japanese 105°C electrolytic capacitors: These premium internal components ensure reliable power delivery and long-term durability.
  • 10-year warranty: Corsair backs the HX series with a generous 10-year warranty, guaranteeing reliable operation for multiple system builds.
  • Switchable +12V rail: A switch on the PSU allows you to toggle between a single +12V rail and multiple +12V rails. Single-rail mode allows all power to be delivered through one channel, while multi-rail mode adds over-current protection for each connector.
  • ATX 3.1 compatible: Newer versions of the HX750 are built with compatibility for the ATX 3.1 standard and modern GPUs from NVIDIA and AMD.

products.title: Corsair RM1000E Gold Full Modular ATX 3.1 PCIe 5.0
products.body_html:
Corsair RM1000E Gold Full Modular ATX 3.1 PCIe 5.0

 

  • 1000W output: The power supply provides 1000 watts of continuous power, with up to 83.3A on the +12V rail, which is sufficient for demanding tasks and high-end gaming rigs.
  • 80 PLUS Gold certified: It offers up to 90% efficiency at steady power output, which means lower power consumption, less heat, and quieter operation.
  • Cybenetics Platinum efficiency: The 
    RM1000e
     has also been independently tested and certified with a Cybenetics Platinum rating, which is based on average efficiency.
  • Electrical performance: Reviews praise its electrical performance, including tight voltage regulation and impressive ripple suppression.
  • Modern standby: The unit supports the Modern Standby feature, which allows for very fast wake-from-sleep times and better efficiency at low loads.

products.title: Corsair RM750E Gold Full Modular ATX 3.1 PCIe 5.0 Corsair RM850E Gold Full Modular ATX 3.1 PCIe 5.0 black / white
products.body_html:
Corsair RM750E Gold Full Modular ATX 3.1 PCIe 5.0 Corsair RM850E Gold Full Modular ATX 3.1 PCIe 5.0 black / white

 

  • RM750e (750W)
    : Ideal for mid-range gaming rigs that might include GPUs like the RTX 5070 or RX 7800 XT. A mid-range system with a single high-end GPU typically consumes less than 750W.
  • RM850e
     (850W): Better for high-end PCs or builds with more power-hungry components, such as the RTX 5080 or 5090. This provides more headroom for power excursions and future upgrades.

products.title: Corsair RM850x Shift Fully Modular 850w / Corsair RM1000x Shift Fully Modular 1000w / Corsair RM1200x Shift Fully Modular 1200w
products.body_html:
Corsair RM850x Shift Fully Modular 850w / Corsair RM1000x Shift Fully Modular 1000w / Corsair RM1200x Shift Fully Modular 1200w

 

  • Side-mounted connectors: The standout feature of the Shift series is the redesigned modular panel. It moves the cable ports from the rear of the unit to the side, making it far easier to access and manage cables, especially in cases with tight space or restrictive PSU shrouds.
  • High efficiency: All models are 80 PLUS Gold and Cybenetics Gold certified, ensuring they operate with high efficiency and produce less heat.
  • Silent operation: A 140mm fluid dynamic bearing (FDB) fan keeps the units cool and runs in Zero RPM fan mode at low and medium loads for near-silent operation.
  • Premium components: The PSUs are built with 100% industrial-grade, 105°C-rated Japanese electrolytic capacitors, ensuring reliable and stable power delivery.
  • ATX 3.1/PCIe 5.1 support: All modern RMx Shift models support the latest ATX and PCIe power standards and come with a native 12V-2x6 connector for compatibility with modern graphics cards.

products.title: Corsair SF750 / 850 / 1000 Platinum Modular ATX3.0 PSU
products.body_html:
Corsair SF750 / 850 / 1000 Platinum Modular ATX3.0 PSU

  • Form factor: The PSUs have a compact SFX form factor, measuring 100 mm in length, which is a standard for SFF builds.
  • Efficiency: All models are 80 PLUS Platinum certified and also carry a Cybenetics Platinum rating.
  • Connectors: The units are fully modular with Type-5 Micro-Fit PSU connectors and include a native 12V-2x6 GPU power cable.
  • Cooling: A 92mm fluid dynamic bearing (FDB) fan provides cooling, featuring a Zero RPM fan mode for silent operation at low to medium loads.
  • Build quality: Reviewers consistently praise the build quality, noting the use of 105°C-rated Japanese capacitors for reliability.
